render.adr: ADR-0245 clause 2: one n per element, from data-tier, data-scale, size and data-density
render.selector: ui-button, ui-toggle, ui-text-field, ui-select, ui-combo-box, ui-card
render.measure: the element's cascade n (its --md-sys-height / 4)
render.expect: resolve(register).n, the register read from the element's own and its ancestors' attributes

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 5 items 1 and 2 (Amendment 3 for button and toggle); a square entry cell (otp-field) is not a pill: see entry-cell-radius (Amendment 6); the segmented control joined in T-0144 (T-0138: single-line controls in one row share h/2)
render.selector: ui-button, ui-toggle, ui-text-field:not([multiline]), ui-select > [data-part='trigger'], ui-combo-box > [data-part='editor'], ui-badge, ui-segmented-control, ui-suggestions [data-part='chip'], ui-file-drop [data-part='chip']
render.measure: border-start-start-radius against the box height

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 3 (geometry.md: icon-only, no label, is square)
render.selector: ui-button with an icon and no label text
render.measure: box width against box height

render.adr: ADR-0245 M5: no type below CFG.floor
render.selector: every element with its own visible text
render.measure: font-size; a glyph is not text (ADR-0245 Amendment 6): ui-glyph and the glyph parts are skipped here and checked by glyph-box

render.adr: T-0130: nothing past the content column at 400px
render.selector: every element inside the content column
render.measure: box right edge against the column's right edge + 4px, unless an overflow-x frame holds it

render.adr: ADR-0046 and the dogfood rule: a card is never the direct content of a card
render.selector: ui-card
render.measure: the nearest ancestor ui-card

render.adr: ADR-0245 clause 3: a single-line control is 4n tall
render.selector: ui-button, ui-toggle, ui-text-field:not([multiline]), ui-select > [data-part='trigger']
render.measure: box height

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 4: the text edge is 2n - c (margin n plus label inset n - c)
render.selector: ui-button:not([icon-only]) > [data-part='label'], ui-text-field:not([multiline]) > [data-part='editor'], ui-toggle
render.measure: host padding-inline-start + the text slot's padding-inline-start

render.adr: ADR-0245 clause 3: a card takes its level radius
render.selector: ui-card
render.measure: border-start-start-radius

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 5 item 3: a listbox panel is concentric, the row pill 2n plus the inset c
render.selector: ui-select [data-part='listbox'], ui-multi-select, ui-combo-box [data-part='listbox']
render.measure: border-start-start-radius (only when the panel has a box)

render.adr: T-0140 (dogfood review part B): a badge is a display atom and hugs its label; a stretching column parent never widens it into a bar
render.selector: ui-badge
render.measure: box width against the badge's max-content width

render.adr: T-0140 (dogfood review part B): a multi-select option shows its toggle in both states, so the control reads as choosable before the first click
render.selector: ui-multi-select > [role='option']
render.measure: the option's ::before box (the indicator)
render.expect: width > 0 in the unselected and the selected state

render.adr: T-0140 (dogfood review part B): a ui-text link or span nested in running text shares the paragraph's line box
render.selector: p > ui-text[as='a'], p > ui-text[as='span'], ui-text > ui-text[as='a'], ui-text > ui-text[as='span']
render.measure: computed display (truncate excepted)

render.adr: T-0140 (dogfood review part B): adjacent trailing adornments (a suffix and the step cells) never glue; ADR-0245 Amendment 4's control gap c
render.selector: ui-text-field > [slot='trailing']:is([data-role='stepper'], [data-role='numeric'])
render.measure: the gap between each pair of adjacent visible children of the trailing cell

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 6: a square entry cell is a round square at radius n, never the pill h/2 (a circle)
render.selector: ui-otp-field [data-part='cell']
render.measure: border-start-start-radius

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 6: icon and glyph are distinct; a glyph sits in its own glyph box 2n - 2c
render.selector: ui-glyph svg, ui-board-grid [data-part='intent'], ui-game-hud [data-part='glyph'], ui-result-card [data-part='glyph']
render.measure: the visible glyph box, both axes

render.adr: T-0141 (review part-c, gauge): under non-scaling-stroke the browser reads a dash pattern in screen px, so a viewBox-unit pattern repeats as scattered dashes
render.selector: every svg shape
render.measure: computed vector-effect and stroke-dasharray
render.expect: never non-scaling-stroke together with a dasharray other than none

render.adr: T-0141 (review part-c, breadcrumb): an anchor inside a fleet control takes the control's ink, never the browser's default link colour
render.selector: a[href] inside a ui-* host
render.measure: the anchor's computed color

render.adr: T-0139 (the fleet disabled recipe, review part-a): a disabled control is always quieter than the same control enabled; the entry fields joined fleet-wide in T-0168 (T-0148)
render.selector: ui-button[disabled], ui-toggle[disabled], ui-text-field[disabled] > [data-part='editor'], ui-textarea[disabled] > [data-part='editor'], ui-otp-field[disabled] > [data-part='cell'], ui-select[disabled] > [data-part='trigger'], ui-combo-box[disabled] > [data-part='editor']
render.measure: the ink's contrast against the control's composited fill, disabled and with the disabled attribute lifted

render.adr: T-0139 (review part-c, pagination): a disabled ghost stays unfilled; a grey pill beside the current page reads as pressed
render.selector: ui-button[variant='ghost'][disabled]
render.measure: the computed background (colour and image)

render.adr: T-0139 (review part-b, switch): a disabled track, box or ring keeps its silhouette against the surface; the entry fields' frames joined fleet-wide in T-0168 (T-0148)
render.selector: ui-switch[disabled], ui-checkbox[disabled], ui-radio[disabled], ui-text-field[disabled], ui-textarea[disabled], ui-otp-field[disabled] > [data-part='cell'], ui-select[disabled] > [data-part='trigger'], ui-combo-box[disabled] > [data-part='editor']
render.measure: the box (a switch, checkbox or radio's ::before; a field's own frame): the better of the fill and the border (over the fill), each composited over the surface, against the surface

render.adr: T-0139 (review part-b, toggle): a disabled unpressed toggle keeps the enabled unpressed fill, so it never reads as pressed
render.selector: ui-toggle[disabled]:not([pressed])
render.measure: the composited background, disabled and with the disabled attribute lifted

render.adr: T-0139 (button.css): a ui-text label inside a button takes the button's ink, so the variant and the disabled recipe show
render.selector: ui-button ui-text
render.measure: the ui-text's computed color against its ui-button's

render.adr: T-0140 (review part-b, avatar): the initials disc separates from the page
render.selector: ui-avatar without an img
render.measure: the disc (its flat gradient plane over its base, over the surface) against the surface behind the avatar

render.adr: T-0142 (review part-a, product-card): a badge over an image has its own opaque pill and readable ink, whatever the photo
render.selector: an absolutely positioned ui-badge whose box overlaps an img, ui-image or [data-part='image']
render.measure: the badge's own layers, flattened without the backdrop, and its ink against them

render.adr: T-0142 (review part-a, composer pickers): a button with no visible glyph and no visible label looks broken
render.selector: ui-button
render.measure: the painted boxes of its icons, glyphs and svgs, and the rendered width of its text
render.expect: an icon box or a text run wider than 0

render.adr: T-0142 (review part-a, CardTable): the buttons of one action group share a line or wrap together, never one at a time
render.selector: a flex row holding two or more ui-buttons and at least one other visible child
render.measure: the buttons' top edges, and which line each shares with a non-button sibling
render.expect: every button on one line, or no button on a line with a non-button sibling

render.adr: T-0142 (review part-a, containers.css): a note under a specimen or a button never sits flush against it
render.selector: p after a visible element sibling that is not a text block
render.measure: the p's top edge against the sibling's bottom edge

render.adr: T-0138 (review part-a, game-hud and result-card): a stat glyph sits n clear of its label (the chip gap)
render.selector: ui-game-hud [data-part='glyph'], ui-result-card [data-part='glyph'], ui-product-card [data-part='rating-stars'] (the rating to its number, T-0146), with a visible next sibling, outside a ui-badge (a status badge's mark keeps the badge rhythm 2c, Amendment 4; T-0170)
render.measure: the inline gap from the glyph to its next sibling

render.adr: T-0138 (review part-b, icon demo): at 400px no demo card is cut by its scroller with no scroll cue
render.selector: ui-card inside an overflow-x frame that is neither a ui-* control nor one of its parts
render.measure: the card's right edge against the frame's right edge

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 7 (T-0143, the 2026-10-14 field boundary ruling): an entry field's resting edge holds at least 3:1 against the page it sits on (SC 1.4.11), in situ on every page, not only in the token test (T-0168)
render.selector: ui-text-field, ui-textarea, ui-otp-field > [data-part='cell'], ui-select > [data-part='trigger'], ui-combo-box > [data-part='editor'], at rest: not disabled, not focused, not user-invalid, not the active OTP cell
render.measure: the top border colour composited over the surface behind the field, against that surface

render.adr: T-0139 and T-0148 (the fleet disabled recipe on the slider, 2026-10-14): a disabled slider keeps its reading, so its fill separates from its rail, and the recipe never grows the thumb
render.selector: ui-slider[disabled]
render.measure: the resolved --ui-slider-fill and --ui-slider-rail, each composited over the surface, against each other; the thumb (.rail::after) block size, disabled and with the disabled attribute lifted
render.expect: fill against rail >= 1.3:1, and the disabled thumb no taller than the enabled one

render.adr: T-0148 (Kim 2026-10-14): the switch off track gets lighter than the on track while its edge keeps at least 3:1 (the field outline role, ADR-0245 Amendment 7)
render.selector: ui-switch:not([disabled]), not checked
render.measure: the track (::before) border composited over the surface, against the surface; the off fill's and the on fill's (--md-sys-color-primary) contrast against the surface
render.expect: edge >= field-outline boundaryMin (3:1), and the off fill quieter than the on fill

render.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 6 and 7 item 3 (Kim's ruling 2026-10-14, icon versus glyph): an icon inside a control or a data-tier region is the 2n icon box; in prose it follows the text (1em). It replaces T-0138's 0.875 x font-size proposal
render.selector: ui-icon (a glyph is checked by glyph-box)
render.measure: the icon's box, both axes; inside means a [data-tier] ancestor or a ui-* control host (not a layout container named in `layout`)
render.expect: inside: resolve(register).icon (2n); in prose: its own font-size (1em)

render.adr: ADR-0105 Amendment 2 as T-0143 capped it and T-0149 start-aligned it (Kim's 2026-10-14 ruling): a stretched calendar grows only until each of its 7 tracks reaches trackFactor x the 4n cell, then keeps to the host's start edge
render.selector: ui-calendar [data-part='panel']
render.measure: the grid's inline size against tracks x trackFactor x the cell (the host's cascade 4n) plus (tracks - 1) column gaps; the panel's start edge against the host's content start, on the side its direction names
render.expect: inline size <= the cap, start edge within 0.5px of the host's

render.adr: ADR-0163 cl.6 (Kim's ruling 2026-10-14): a table's pager sits outside its scroll frame, so paging never scrolls away with a wide row
render.selector: ui-pagination a control composes (its nearest ui-* host is not a layout container named in icon-box's `layout`, so a page's own pager is out)
render.measure: every ancestor between the pager and its nearest ui-* host
render.expect: none scrolls on the inline axis (overflow-x auto or scroll)

render.adr: T-0149 (round-3 data review): a ui-table whose columns run past its frame shows the edge-fade cue, so a cut column never reads as a complete table
render.selector: ui-table [data-part='scroll'] whose scroll width exceeds its client width
render.measure: computed mask-image (and -webkit-mask-image)

render.adr: T-0149 (round-3 data review, stat): sibling ring tiles in one row draw one ring diameter
render.selector: ui-stat[variant='ring'] [data-part='ring'], grouped by the nearest ancestor holding two or more rings, on one line
render.measure: each ring's box width
render.expect: every ring on a line within 0.5px of the first

render.adr: T-0149 (round-3 data review, gauge): the legend starts just past the outer ring, so rings and legend read as one group
render.selector: ui-gauge [data-part='legend'] rows beside (on the line of) the rings
render.measure: the gap between the first legend row and the outer ring's painted box, on whichever side of the rings the row sits (so LTR and RTL both read)

render.adr: T-0149 (round-3 data review, chart-axis cl.6): series 1 and 2 of a chart sit far enough apart to tell apart in a stacked chart
render.selector: ui-bar-chart, ui-column-chart, ui-line-chart, ui-pie-chart
render.measure: --ui-chart-series-1-ink against --ui-chart-series-2-ink, each resolved for the chart's colour scheme

render.adr: T-0149 (round-3 data review, chart chips): a chart chip over a bar keeps its own opaque fill and readable ink
render.selector: the tick-label, category-label and callout chips of ui-column-chart and ui-line-chart that paint a fill (a border-only or shadow-only chip has none)
render.measure: the chip's own layers flattened without the backdrop, and its ink against them

render.adr: T-0149 (round-3 data review): a chart with no data still draws an empty frame or track, never a blank box that reads as a failed render
render.selector: ui-bar-chart, ui-column-chart, ui-gauge whose data is an empty array
render.measure: the painted boxes of the host's ::before (with content) and its descendants (a fill, a border or an svg stroke)

render.adr: T-0149 (round-3 data review, bar chart): a chart with a negative value draws its zero rule
render.selector: ui-bar-chart [data-origin] (a track the chart marks as diverging)
render.measure: the track's ::before (the zero rule)
render.expect: generated (content not none or normal) and displayed, with a border wider than 0

render.adr: T-0147 (round-3 app review, composer placeholder): an ellipsis is three dots or none, never two
render.selector: a ui-* host or element with a placeholder
render.measure: the placeholder text
render.expect: never ends in exactly two periods

render.adr: T-0147 (round-3 app review, Mode picker) and the no-em-dash house rule: picker and control labels carry no em dash
render.selector: [role='option'], [role='menuitem'], [role='menuitemradio'], [role='menuitemcheckbox'], [role='tab'], [role='radio'], ui-tab, ui-radio, ui-segment, ui-choice-card, ui-button, ui-toggle, ui-segmented-control, ui-select > [data-part='trigger']
render.measure: the visible text

render.adr: T-0150 (round-3 demo review): the mono .demo-caption labels the [attr] a figure demonstrates; product text inside a specimen never wears it
render.selector: .demo-caption
render.measure: its ancestors up to the column

render.adr: T-0150 (round-3 demo review): sibling captioned figures on one line share their top edge, so a size row compares the specimens
render.selector: .demo-figure siblings on one line
render.measure: each figure's top edge against the first figure's on that line

render.adr: T-0150 (round-3 demo review): an overline labels the block after it, so it sits closer to that block than to the one before
render.selector: ui-text[variant='overline'] with a visible previous and next sibling
render.measure: the gap to the next sibling against the gap to the previous

render.adr: T-0150 (round-3 demo review, avatar cluster): overlapping avatars wear a ring and cover at most a quarter of their neighbour
render.selector: adjacent ui-avatar siblings whose boxes overlap
render.measure: the overlap against the earlier avatar's width; the later avatar's box-shadow, outline or border
render.expect: overlap <= width / widthDivisor (a quarter), and a ring painted

render.adr: T-0150 (round-3 demo review): a supporting line reads quieter than the name it supports
render.selector: .demo-supporting after a visible text block sibling (its title)
render.measure: its ink contrast against its backdrop, and the previous sibling's

render.adr: T-0146 (round-3 widget review, word board): a board letter's cap height fills at least a third of its cell
render.selector: ui-board-grid [data-part='cell'] holding one letter
render.measure: the cap height of the letter's computed font (canvas actualBoundingBoxAscent of H) against the cell's block size

render.adr: T-0146 (round-3 widget review, board frame): a control that paints no frame starts its first painted box on its own start edge, so it lines up with the text edge around it
render.selector: ui-board-grid that paints no background, border or shadow
render.measure: its first visible cell's start edge against the host's start edge, on the side its direction names

compose.adr: T-0135: a date is a real input
compose.use: ui-text-field type=date (A2UI: a TextField of type date)
compose.not: a ui-calendar inside a ui-popover, or beside a calendar-icon ui-button, standing in for a date field (A2UI: a Calendar inside a Popover or FormPopover)
compose.detect: a file that creates ui-calendar and also ui-popover, ui-form-popover or an icon=calendar ui-button; a payload whose Popover or FormPopover lists a Calendar child

compose.adr: ADR-0243: a board of cells is ui-board-grid
compose.not: a ui-grid of cell ui-buttons (A2UI: a Grid whose children are all Buttons)
compose.detect: a payload Grid with three or more explicit children that are all Buttons, or a template child that is a Button; a file that appends ui-buttons into a ui-grid inside a loop

compose.adr: T-0172 (Kim's ruling, 2026-10-14): a choice is a plain Button in a row, never a framed box per Button
compose.use: one Row of plain Buttons (A2UI: a Row whose children are the Buttons), or a ChoicePicker or SegmentedControl
compose.not: a Card whose only content is one Button, directly or through a lone CardContent or CardFooter (a bordered box around each choice)
compose.detect: a payload Card whose sole child, or sole CardContent or CardFooter child, is a Button

compose.adr: ADR-0245 Amendment 6 (Kim's ruling 2026-10-14, icon versus glyph): a control's caret or chevron is a glyph in its glyph box, never an icon (T-0148 and T-0149 moved them to ui-glyph)
compose.not: setIcon(host, 'caret-*'), or a ui-icon named caret-*, inside a control's source
compose.detect: setIcon( with a caret-* name, a name attribute or key set to caret-*, or <ui-icon name="caret-*"> markup, in a control source

compose.adr: T-0146 (round-3 widget review, ProductCard rating): a rating is ui-rating (A2UI: the ProductCard rating or a Rating), never a run of star characters inside a ui-* host
compose.use: ui-rating readonly (A2UI: a ProductCard rating, a Rating)
compose.not: a string of two or more U+2605 or U+2606 star characters
compose.detect: a run of two or more U+2605 or U+2606 in a composition source, comments excluded

compose.adr: ADR-0245 clause 1: every margin, gutter, radius, height and type size derives from n
compose.use: the derived tokens and the control's own size or the container's data-* register
compose.not: an inline style that sets padding, margin, gap, radius, height or font-size to a literal length
compose.detect: .style.<prop> = '<length>', .style.cssText, .style.setProperty('<prop>', '<length>'), a style="..." attribute or a style: '...' key, for a geometry property with a px, rem or em literal other than 0 and the 1px hairline

exempt.reason: the scroll specimen's max-block-size is the frame that makes scroll mode show; a specimen frame, not composition (T-0170)
the min-block-size on each ui-column specimen is the frame its justify and fill modes show in; a specimen frame (T-0170)
the tile photo's block-size is page content standing in for an image, not geometry of a control (T-0170)
the min-block-size on each ui-list justify specimen is the frame the mode shows in; a specimen frame (T-0170)
the min-block-size on each ui-row align specimen and its tall box is the frame the alignment shows in; a specimen frame (T-0170)
the literal styles live in the HTML the opaque-origin sandbox renders, where no token reaches (ADR-0073 trust boundary); the host side uses tokens (T-0170)
